A direct "Christelle Briois" LinkedIn profile that matches her LPC2E/CNRS-Orleans identity was NOT located via the searches performed. The relevant LinkedIn hits all returned near-namesakes, none of which match the institutional email (Christelle.Briois@cnrs-orleans.fr) or the LPC2E / Universite d'Orleans / mass-spectrometry field:

**What was checked:** site:linkedin.com queries for "Christelle Briois LPC2E" and "Christelle Briois CNRS Orleans", plus general web searches with LinkedIn-bound phrasing. **What was not checked:** logging into a LinkedIn account to query the directory (out of scope for this research pass); the gated LinkedIn Sales-Navigator / Recruiter view. **Net assessment:** **No verified public evidence of a personal LinkedIn profile** for Christelle Briois was located; if she has one, it is not indexed under the exact spelling "Christelle Briois" alongside LPC2E/CNRS-Orleans identifiers in the public-web search index.
content.confidence_and_caveats:
Confidence ladder:

- **Identity: HIGH.** Three independent matches (LPC2E annuaire email, ResearchGate, IEEE Xplore bio, ORCID) all confirm name + LPC2E + Universite d'Orleans + mass spectrometry/COSIMA/Rosetta. No namesaked overlap found for "Christelle Briois" in the chemistry / planetary science data spaces.
- **Group: MEDIUM.** The annuaire does not name the subgroup; the LPC2E Planetologie theme page names Briois as contact for the team. The "Physical & Chemical Instrumentation of Space" subgroup name (per the lead brief) is consistent with her instrument-development output but I did not retrieve a direct page enumerating Physical & Chemical Instrumentation of Space members on LPC2E in this pass.
- **Funding (competitive, 2024+): LOW.** Searches did not surface a public award listing with Briois as PI + a 2024+ award date + a public amount. Institutional / mission-line funding is well documented (CNES support for CosmOrbitrap; ESA ROSETTA/COSIMA) but is not a personal competitive grant.
- **Open Positions in her subgroup (2026+): LOW.** No cometary/mass-spec PhD or postdoc indexed under her name was found in EURAXESS, CNRS emploi, LPC2E home, AcademicPositions, or Adum snapshots. Nearby LPC2E offers exist but are solar-terrestrial (Pierre Henri team).
- **LinkedIn: LOW (negative result).** No verified direct match. Several near-namesakes returned and were individually ruled out.

Known caveats:

- HAL depositor pages (insu.hal.science) issue Anubis Proof-of-Work challenges; full-text acknowledgement parsing was not possible in this pass and would require a different scraping route (DOI to publisher, ResearchGate copy, or direct PDF download).
- ORCID's page returned no extractable citations under extract(); the fields are likely rendered client-side.
- The data.anr.fr open data portal lists call *editions* but the per-project search/filter UI was not navigated end-to-end; the AAPG 2025 listing was behind a verification page when accessed.
- "Active now" claims rely on LPC2E Planetologie page and HAL depositor dates; CNES support is described in present tense on the LPC2E page, which is taken as reasonable evidence of an active project as of the page publication.
content.recommendations:
- **Re-query funding via CORDIS (Horizon Europe / ERC) filtered for Briois.** The CORDIS projects search supports person-name filtering and would resolve the competitive-grants gap.
- **Re-query ANR per-project** at data.anr.fr using the LPC2E keyword and the SU/ST2/PE/PI planetary-science committee codes.
- **Bypass Anubis on HAL** by going through the DOI route (via Crossref) or ResearchGate copies; the funding acknowledgement sections of OLYMPIA and Laser-CosmOrbitrap papers are the most likely place to find CNES / ANR numbers for Briois's 2023-2026 instrument work.
- **For hiring signals, watch Adum (French national PhD registry), GdR PIlSe newsletter, and the LPC2E intranet at the start of each French academic year (September) and after CNES doctoral call openings (usually January-February).**
- **For LinkedIn, retry with the less-common spelling variants "Christelle Briois" (one "o") and "Briois, Christelle" and check ResearchGate / Academia.edu directly.** She has an Academia.edu profile ([recommendations[0]] [9]) and a Google Scholar profile - persona presence exists outside LinkedIn.
